$comment: Ceilings for `npm run perf:budget` / `perf:budget:ci` (size: bytes / counts) and `npm run perf` (scenario medians: ms / MB / s / %). Ratcheted to the YAZ-2073 build in 7A (the v0.1.11 numbers they replaced are in baseline.json; the before/after table is thoughts/yaz-2073-scope/before-after.md): a size is the packaged build's own value; a time is its interleaved A/B median plus about 5 % (storm's CPU and IPC stall: 0.5 s and 12 ms, near their p95 under load). Frame times read this Mac's display (a 10 ms frame); rerun `npm run perf` on another display before trusting them. Ceilings the A/B run showed unchanged keep their v0.1.11 value. THE RATCHET (🔒 D17): a change that improves a metric lowers its ceiling here in the same PR; raising one needs Yasin's OK in the PR description. `target` is the YAZ-2073 goal (hover preview times include the 400 ms dwell, so 700 = the scope's 300 ms). The tolerances absorb build-to-build byte jitter and run-to-run timing noise, nothing more.
